title: Public Utilities Act
verified_how: fetched Alberta King's Printer Laws Online catalogue entry (ISBN 9780779848621): title 'Public Utilities Act', Chapter/Regulation 'R.S.A. 2000, c. P-45', Status 'Office Consolidation', Current to 6/21/2024; the Laws Online index header states 'Acts current to 2026-08-31'
notes: The catalogue describes it as enabling the Alberta Utilities Commission to regulate 'the rates and terms and conditions of service' of investor-owned water utilities, with some provisions applying to investor-owned and some municipally owned electric utilities. Electricity retail billing and the regulated rate option run alongside it under the Electric Utilities Act, S.A. 2003, c. E-5.1 (ISBN 9780779860913), and the tribunal is constituted by the Alberta Utilities Commission Act, S.A. 2007, c. A-37.2 (ISBN 9780779860906). This is the least current consolidation in the Alberta set (current to 21 June 2024).
